note: The original was published as Constrictotermes discolor and later transferred to Caribitermes; this entry is based only on the original soldier description, with no worker or alate description.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head pale yellowish brown, the nasus browner than the rest of the body; antennae brown; anterior part of the pronotum brownish; abdominal tergites darker brown; venter and legs pale. Head pyriform, the vertex less rounded than usual, slightly constricted below the middle; nasus long and slender, all parts with fine hairs, most very short and a few longer; antennae slender, segment 3 only slightly longer than 2; legs and body with fine hairs. Body length 3.2 mm, head length 1.4 mm. Resembles C. toussainti and C. flaveolus in the slightly constricted head, but the nasus is much longer and more slender than in either; head colour paler than in C. toussainti and darker than in C. flaveolus; head hairs finer than in C. toussainti, antennae much longer than in C. flaveolus; head constriction less pronounced than in either.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head pale yellowish brown, the nasus browner than the rest of the body; antennae brown; anterior part of the pronotum brownish; abdominal tergites darker brown, venter and legs pale. Head pyriform, the vertex less rounded than usual, slightly constricted below the middle; nasus long and slender; all parts with fine hairs, most very short and a few longer; antennae slender, segment 3 only slightly longer than 2; legs and body with fine hairs. Body length 3.2 mm, head length 1.4 mm. Compared with Constrictotermes toussainti and C. flaveolus: the nasus much longer and more slender than in either; head colour paler than in C. toussainti and darker than in C. flaveolus; head hairs finer than in C. toussainti; antennae much longer than in C. flaveolus; head constriction less pronounced than in either.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Type localities Adjuntas (8—12 June, month 6) and Manati (27—29 June, month 6), Puerto Rico; also recorded from Culebra Island (5 March, month 3, A. M. N. H.) and El Yunque, Puerto Rico (February, month 2, collected by Stejneger, U. S. N. M.). Holotype A. M. N. H., paratypes M. C. Z. 10,084.
